China-Bangladesh Teesta Project Sparks Indian Concerns

Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has vowed to implement the Teesta Barrage Master Plan, stating it will be completed "at any cost" following a visit to China. This commitment has raised concerns in India, with reports indicating China's support for the project. The Teesta project is described as significant for Bangladesh's water security and agriculture.
